reviews.review:
Being a very big fan of the left 4 dead series I had high hopes for this game as did many others. Buyer beware even on a sale this game is pretty dead and on top of that it will never match your nostalgia for actual L4D. Worst part is they haven't even implemented being able to play versus online. Swarm mode lets be honest is total sh1t and nobody even takes it seriously it will never be fun. Original L4D with versus on the actual campaign maps is the way to go for a PRIMARY pvp mode - not saying to delete swarm but it could encourage actual pvp if there was a similar core to L4D. Other than that this game is a very expensive garbage remake of L4D that some devs were able to spray paint gold. The card system for campaigns is literally the dumbest thing in the game. Didn't anyone learn about loot box ♥♥♥♥ from Battlefront 2? But we still just do this same routine pitch in every game along with DLC? 
Seems that the current trend of gaming is have a fun idea - then murder your players with DLC and other lootbox ♥♥♥♥ while the core of the game will never be fun at least you can tweak your character to do melee better. Cool.
Overall this game has given me hopes that being so bad L4D3 will actually be sparked into the universe and we'll be blessed with an actual zombie game to play. 
To anyone saying THEYRE A DIFF COMPANY THEY DONT HAVE TO DO WHAT L4D DID - just stop - this game deserves zero redemption and you know it. Beyond 10 hours of maybe forced gameplay through the maps it's unbearable to play

This is not equal with, but is a decent spiritual successor to Left 4 Dead. I grew up on L4D/L4d2. It's in my DNA. I have an addiction and I can scratch that itch with B4B almost as well. The only difference for me is that I play with bots or friends co-op since PvP is basically dead, and I can't mod it. I actually like the card system and how stupid the abilities can get. It feels like a form of the old Mutations. It overall lacks the personality that L4D had, but it does achieve the same linear shoot-loot-run to saferoom design. Feels good enough ¯\_(ツ)_/¯

I enjoy playing Back 4 Blood, but it's fun is with other players.  The AI is not the brightest when to comes to helping you.  Plus, an AI respond as quickly as a human player on a mic.  Still the game is fun to play, hope they keep up the support.
